catalogClauses.base: The caster plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit, draining its health, while simultaneously slowing it. The seed heals friendly units around it.
catalogClauses.differences: Multiple Leech Seed debuffs can be placed on the same unit simultaneously.
catalogClauses.super: Super: Turns into an area of effect spell where the hero spills a green puddle that leeches in a 300 unit radius. Increases movement slow by 15% and damage/heal per second by 50.

catalogClauses.base:
The hero draws upon their health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of their target's current health, and slowing them. While leaping, the hero is Spell Immune.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
catalogClauses.differences: AI: Targets the farthest unit from the hero.

catalogClauses.gaben: Gaben: Life Break taunts the target for 3 seconds. Grants Gaben's Gauntlets, which has the value of 15 Gauntlets of Strength (+45 Strength).

catalogClauses.base:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, the caster drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target. If the caster has full HP, and the enemy target is a Hero, Life Drain will restore mana instead.

When cast on an ally, the caster will drain his own health into his ally.
catalogClauses.differences: AI: heals allies if they're low HP, but only if caster is above 90% HP.
catalogClauses.super: Super: For every 1 seconds of channel, another secondary Life Drain is created targeting another random enemy hero.
catalogClauses.gaben: Gaben: Removes cooldown and increases damage by 200.
